datasets.name: 77bb2df8
queryLines:
WITH g AS (SELECT period, SUM(usd_list) AS usd FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.genie_usage t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT usd FROM g WHERE period = 'current'), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS value,
       concat('Before $', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT usd FROM g WHERE period = 'previous'), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS STRING)) AS target

datasets.name: 19b743ff
queryLines:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT period, SUM(dbus) AS dbus, SUM(CASE WHEN is_free THEN dbus ELSE 0 END) AS free_dbus
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.genie_usage t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT dbus FROM g WHERE period = 'current'), 0), 0) AS value,
       concat('Free tier: ', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT free_dbus FROM g WHERE period = 'current'), 0), 0) AS STRING), ' DBU') AS target

datasets.name: fc5a2df0
queryLines:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT period, CASE WHEN identity_type = 'service_principal' OR (channel IS NOT NULL AND channel <> '' AND upper(channel) <> 'UI')
            THEN 'Built into apps or agents'
            WHEN upper(COALESCE(channel, '')) = 'UI' AND identity_type = 'user' THEN 'People in the browser'
            ELSE 'Not recorded' END AS use_kind, usd_list
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.genie_usage t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
),
s AS (SELECT period, use_kind, SUM(usd_list) AS usd FROM u GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT usd FROM s WHERE period = 'current' AND use_kind = 'Built into apps or agents'), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS value,
       concat('Browser $', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT usd FROM s WHERE period = 'current' AND use_kind = 'People in the browser'), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS STRING)) AS target

WITH g AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.genie_usage t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND period = 'current')
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN identity_type = 'user' AND dbus <> 0 THEN run_as END) FROM g) AS value,
       concat('Workspaces: ', CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT workspace_id) FROM g) AS STRING),
              '; agents: ', CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id) FROM g) AS STRING)) AS target

datasets.name: e0f0f1d0
queryLines:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT CASE surface WHEN 'GENIE_CODE' THEN 'Genie Code' WHEN 'GENIE_AGENTS' THEN 'Genie agents'
            WHEN 'GENIE_ONE' THEN 'Genie One' ELSE 'Not recorded' END AS kind, period, SUM(dbus) AS dbus, SUM(usd_list) AS usd
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.genie_usage t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT c.kind, ROUND(c.dbus, 0) AS dbus, ROUND(c.usd * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd,
       ROUND(100.0 * (c.usd - COALESCE(p.usd, 0)) / NULLIF(p.usd, 0), 1) AS chg_pct
FROM (SELECT * FROM g WHERE period = 'current') c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM g WHERE period = 'previous') p ON p.kind = c.kind
ORDER BY c.usd DESC

datasets.name: baa2e18c
datasets.displayName: usage:Who uses Genie, where and how
queryLines:
SELECT CASE WHEN identity_type = 'service_principal' THEN concat('service principal (', run_as, ')') ELSE COALESCE(run_as, 'Not recorded') END AS who,
       nm_workspace AS workspace,
       CASE surface WHEN 'GENIE_CODE' THEN 'Genie Code' WHEN 'GENIE_AGENTS' THEN 'Genie agents'
            WHEN 'GENIE_ONE' THEN 'Genie One' ELSE 'Not recorded' END AS kind,
       CASE WHEN channel IS NULL OR channel = '' THEN 'Not recorded' WHEN upper(channel) = 'UI' THEN 'UI' ELSE concat('Non-UI . ', channel) END AS channel,
       ROUND(SUM(dbus), 0) AS dbus,
       ROUND(SUM(usd_list) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd
FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.genie_usage t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND period = 'current'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
HAVING SUM(dbus) <> 0 OR SUM(usd_list) <> 0
ORDER BY usd DESC
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: d608cfba
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'genie_usage', 'Genie usage by workspace and surface', 'Genie')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

datasets.name: 76914c3c
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), NULL) AS `workspace_shown`,
  CAST(t.`usage_date` AS STRING) AS `usage_date`,
  t.`period` AS `period`,
  t.`surface` AS `surface`,
  t.`channel` AS `channel`,
  t.`agent_id` AS `agent_id`,
  t.`identity_type` AS `identity_type`,
  t.`run_as` AS `run_as`,
  CAST(t.`is_free` AS STRING) AS `is_free`,
  t.`dbus` AS `dbus`,
  t.`usd_list` AS `usd_list`,
  t.`unpriced_dbus` AS `unpriced_dbus`,
  t.`price_basis` AS `price_basis`,
  CAST(t.`previous_period_covered` AS STRING) AS `previous_period_covered`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.genie_usage t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) n_workspace
  ON n_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(n_workspace.n, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY `usage_date` DESC NULLS LAST, `usd_list` DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000
